title: bumper.toml
description: Repository settings for bumper, the git semantic version bumper. Command line flags beat environment variables, which beat this file, which beats the defaults.

paths.description: Additional repository-relative files or directories to bump. Adds to the paths given by flags and environment variables.

ignore-directories.description: Repository-relative directories to ignore. Ignored trees do not contribute commits, packages, version files, or dependency updates. Adds to the directories given by flags and environment variables.

major-types.description: Conventional commit types that trigger a major version bump.

minor-types.description: Conventional commit types that trigger a minor version bump.

patch-types.description: Conventional commit types that trigger a patch version bump.

skip-scopes.description: Conventional commit scopes to skip when determining the version bump.

fixed-version.description: Give every package the same version, releasing all of them when any releases. Puts every package in one version group, in place of any configured groups.

groups.description: Named version groups. Packages in the same group always release together at one version; other packages keep their own versions. A package can belong to only one group.

additionalProperties.description: A version group, whose members release at the highest impact in the group, applied to their highest current version.

packages.description: Repository-relative package directories (`.` is the root) or patterns, where `*` matches within one directory name and `**` matches any number of directories. Every entry must match a discovered package.
